graph_family: all labeled simple graphs on n vertices
polynomial_definition: For each labeled simple graph G and ordered pair (e1,e2) of distinct edges, p_(G,e1,e2)(x) = x when |e1 intersection e2| = 1 and p_(G,e1,e2)(x) = 0 otherwise; sum these polynomials over all G and all ordered edge pairs.
source_derivation: The original source treats the double sum as unordered, counting each incident edge pair once rather than in both orientations, yielding half the correct coefficient.
